=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:486-492 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "created after the approval" filter and the "90 days after approval" abandon rule need an approval timestamp, but no input the gate reads carries one (marker at 457 has no approved field, GraphQL returns only cross-reference events, approve step writes no date).
  WHY: The gate cannot evaluate either condition, so an older tracking issue can be mis-bound and abandoned sessions keep occupying slots; severity disagreement: MAJOR (sonnet, gemini, luna, glm) vs BLOCKER (minimax), highest used.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:374 vs 457-466 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The session body marker is specified in two incompatible formats (short at line 374, full with tracking/checked/ledger at 457).
  WHY: A writer built from one section and a parser built from the other disagree, so resume and ledger parsing fail; severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet), MAJOR (luna, glm), BLOCKER (gemini, minimax), highest used.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:654-663, 693-699 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The reusable workflow needs contents/issues/pull-requests write plus id-token, but the consumer template is specified with only `id-token: write`.
  WHY: A caller's permissions cap the callee's GITHUB_TOKEN, so session issue and comment writes fail with 403 or startup fails; severity disagreement: MAJOR (sonnet) vs BLOCKER (gemini, minimax, luna), highest used.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:617-626, 218, 750 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Phase 1 step 4 omits the `outcome` stage that Flow step 4 (line 218) and Phase 3 step 4 (line 750) rely on.
  WHY: The engine could ship without an outcome stage, leaving Flow step 4 a no-op; severity BLOCKER. Note: sonnet and glm explicitly judged this a deliberate phase split (Phase 3 adds the hook) and not a gap.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:218 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Flow step 4 says "both seats, one joint comment" but does not define who composes the joint comment.
  WHY: Implementations diverge on drafting and stitching, and resume cannot rebuild the outcome turn; severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, glm) vs MAJOR (gemini, minimax), highest used.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:656-658, 674-677, 727-738 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The template structure is unspecified, and `gate` and `session` jobs are not excluded on `issue_comment` events; only `command` is conditioned.
  WHY: Owner comments can start gate/session and open or resume sessions, and an AND-ed `if:` on a single caller job would stop schedule runs; severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet) vs MAJOR (others), highest used.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:656-658, 793 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Stub-seat behaviour has two names: the `stub_seats` workflow_call input (656-658) and the `BRAINSTORM_STUB_SEATS=true` env var (793).
  WHY: Setting only one channel either spends pool quota or honours stubs where it must not; severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, glm) vs MAJOR (minimax), highest used.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:153, 696 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan cites runner concurrency as "§26", but in CLAUDE.md that is §33 (§26 is Post-Push PR Status Check-In).
  WHY: A reader or implementer checks the wrong rule for the job-count justification.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:173-188, 479-496 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The §15 API budget lists one aliased GraphQL read but omits up to 10 body edits, label/close writes, and per-due-topic session leg costs.
  WHY: The documented per-run budget understates real usage; severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, glm) vs MAJOR (minimax), highest used.
- CI check-runs `lint` and `static-checks` on head bf9eafa (`scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh`) | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Both CI failures are the stale merge-ref guard (`outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed`), not mapped to the diff.
  WHY: The log says this is not a defect in the PR; a base refresh is needed and no repo edit applies.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json`: the seven labels (Phase 2 step 9 and Labels section); Phase 2 Done: wrapper integrity and size tests pass
  expected_change_site: scripts/label_helpers.sh (`_AI_LABEL_COLORS`, `_AI_LABEL_DESCS`) and the Files & Modules list at lines 761-790
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: tests/test_ai_labels.py:278-285 asserts contract labels, colors and descriptions equal the helper's; plan lists only the JSON file (lines 702, 774), so the test fails and `ensure_label_exists` lacks color/description.
- requirement: Phase 1 and Phase 2 "Done" conditions require existing gates to pass; Files & Modules (lines 761-790) names every new scripts/brainstorm_*, prompts/mode-brainstorm-*.txt and workflow file
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md (or tests/inventory_exemptions.txt)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: tests/inventory_parity.py (run by ci.yml line 2769) requires each tracked workflow, prompts/mode-*.txt and scripts/* file in docs/INVENTORY.md; the plan never mentions docs/INVENTORY.md.
- requirement: Phase 1 step 3: `prompts/mode-brainstorm-*.txt` [new]: one per stage
  expected_change_site: first line and length of each new prompt file
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: tests/prompt_size_budget.py:30,57 requires `# tier: DEFAULT|LARGE|XL` first line and a 250-line DEFAULT limit; the plan says nothing about it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:486-492 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Approval-relative rules need an approval time that no gate input carries.
  WHY: Older tracking issues can be bound and abandoned sessions hold slots; fix is an approved=<YYYY-MM-DD> marker field.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:374 vs 457 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Two marker formats; first section does not say the second extends it.
  WHY: Writer and parser can disagree and goal 9's ledger gets no field.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:656, 793 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `stub_seats` input vs `BRAINSTORM_STUB_SEATS` env var.
  WHY: Quota spend or stubs honoured where they must not be.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:153, 696 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Runner concurrency cited as §26; it is §33 in CLAUDE.md (CLAUDE.md:1549).
  WHY: Reader opens the wrong rule.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:655-678, 727-737 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Template structure unspecified; gate/session not skipped on issue_comment.
  WHY: Schedule runs may stop or owner comments may start sessions; "1 command job" claim is wrong.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:218 | severity=NIT | confidence=2

  WHY: Implementations differ and resume cannot rebuild the turn.
- CI check-runs `lint` and `static-checks` on head bf9eafa | severity=NIT | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: Failures are the stale merge-ref guard (`CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF ... outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed`); the gemini "actionlint failing" claim has no log support.
  WHY: Not a PR defect; no repo edit applies.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:173-184, 479-496 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The §15 budget omits body edits, label and close calls, and counts session recheck per job, not per due topic.
  WHY: The per-run budget is understated.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:693-699 vs 661-662 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Template permissions list only `id-token: write`; the reusable workflow needs contents/issues/pull-requests write (precedent workflow-templates/ai-security-audit.yml:21-27).
  WHY: The caller caps token scope, so the call fails or writes 403.
- TASK_GAP: label_contract / label_helpers.sh (MAJOR, confidence=5)
  Requirement: Phase 2 step 9 and Labels section: "`.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json`: the seven labels"
  Expected change site: `scripts/label_helpers.sh`, `_AI_LABEL_COLORS` and `_AI_LABEL_DESCS`, plus Files & Modules list at lines 761-790
  Evidence of absence: tests/test_ai_labels.py:278-285 asserts the contract equals the helper catalogs; plan lists only the JSON file (lines 702, 774).

  Expected change site: `docs/INVENTORY.md` or `tests/inventory_exemptions.txt`
  Evidence of absence: tests/inventory_parity.py (ci.yml line 2769) requires every new workflow, prompt and script in INVENTORY.md; the plan never mentions it.
- TASK_GAP: prompt tier header (NIT, confidence=4)
  Requirement: Phase 1 step 3: `prompts/mode-brainstorm-*.txt` [new]: one per stage
  Expected change site: first line and length of each prompt
  Evidence of absence: tests/prompt_size_budget.py:30,57 requires the tier header and a 250-line DEFAULT limit.
- HARDENING: docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md lines 372-376 and 463 — state that the engine writes the marker as the first body line and escapes `<!--` in model-authored text (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2)
